statement: Written and committed BEFORE any TEST field of any run/pred/conf file was read in this stage. TEST is evaluated once, no changes afterwards.

primary_system.name: CulinaryNER-KF v1
primary_system.seed_policy: seed 1 model for calibrator/router (5-fold OOF seed 1); span-quality also reported over all trained seeds (TASTEset 5, RecipeDB3 3)
primary_system.checkpoint_rule: max dev exact micro F1 (benchmark rule)
primary_system.calibrator: logistic+isotonic on [logit span conf, M6 exact, M6 fuzzy], fit on OOF train spans
primary_system.router: R6 eps=0.02 label x seen/unseen strata thresholds from CALIBRATION, REJECT if P<1/3, linker advisory only (NOVEL never an action)
primary_system.linker: FROZEN OPERATIONAL LINKER = BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5, fmt none, cls pool, lr 1e-5, 4 epochs, linker_data_v2, seed 1 for export; E5-large-v2 documented Pareto alternative, NOT evaluated for selection on TEST

challenger.label: FROZEN ACCURACY/COMPUTE CHALLENGER
challenger.use: span-quality + compute only; may not replace v1 based on TEST
challenger.note: same benchmark-frozen training config as E0; no separate calibrator/router built

disclosures: TASTEset TEST aggregates for E0 models were viewed once at E0 (corrected; recorded in contract/amendment A1); no selection since.
Run JSONs contain test metrics computed at training time; not read for any decision before this manifest.
linker unseen_alias / unseen_concept sets were viewed repeatedly as report-only sets during development; never used for selection.
